data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard includes line, bar, and area charts.
Charts display LLM cost over time, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
Data updates in real-time or simulates real-time updates.

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Showcase cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics with charts.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are displayed using appropriate Chart.js visualizations.
Charts accurately represent cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning.
Data is clearly presented and easy to interpret.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart represents TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Metrics are accurate and clearly displayed.
Chart is interactive and informative.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Chart.js library is included and functional within the HTML file.
Visualizations include pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
Charts are interactive and animated.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline is represented as a Chart.js visualization.
Each stage is clearly labeled and distinct.
Visualization is interactive and informative.

features.title: Results Presentation
features.description: Show real metrics from recent runs in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are up-to-date and accurately represented.
Data is presented in a clear and concise manner.
Charts and visualizations enhance understanding of the results.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.
Data is easy to understand and interpret.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality and navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML presentation using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation is a single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Templates from specified directory are used as a base.
Output file is saved as /tmp/artemis_demo_chartjs.html.

features.title: HERO Section Development
features.description: Create a HERO section explaining what Artemis is.
acceptance_criteria: HERO section clearly defines Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
Section is visually engaging and informative.
Content is concise and easy to understand.

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Enhance the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background.
Slide transitions are smooth and visually appealing.
Overall design is consistent and professional.
